changes: Group messages expose copy and explicit speech in the same action list used by pointer buttons and focused message shortcuts. Null/undecrypted bodies do not offer copy, speech or empty edit operations. Speech uses existing account rate/language without enabling automatic reading.

Shared ignore-policy hook and reveal scope now cover channel, 1:1 DM and group messages. Ignored content stays behind an explicit reveal; reveals do not transfer between accounts, privacy-policy objects, conversation, message identity, author, body or edit revision. Spam quarantine remains independent and takes precedence.
Shared quote/search/forward preview wrapper suppresses ignored plaintext and caller-provided preview children in channel, DM and group contexts, without changing delivery, membership or block state.

Legacy clipboard fallback now checks execCommand's boolean result, rejects unavailable/failed copying, always removes its temporary plaintext textarea and restores focus/selection. Copy callers surface failures rather than producing false success or unhandled rejection. Browser and Electron clipboard preference is unchanged.
verification: After shared reveal-hook integration: 5 focused files / 29 tests passed; targeted ESLint passed and tsc -b passed.

Tests cover hidden pointer/keyboard actions, explicit reveal, account/policy/content changes, null message bodies, all preview kinds, own-message exceptions, speech/clipboard failure, browser/native/legacy clipboard, cleanup and focus restoration.

An initial GroupSpamGate test mock lacked initReactI18next after adding the account store; replaced the incomplete mock with the existing partial-mock pattern. Tests then passed without skipping or weakening assertions.

Correct project-reference typecheck tsc -b found and fixed nullable reveal-state access; prior solution-level tsc --noEmit did not traverse references and was insufficient evidence. Current tsc -b passed.
